_about: MH3U .mrl v0x20 read through LtUserShaderPackage.lfx (MFX v52) by mh3u_mrl.py. Per material: t.albedo the tAlbedoMap binding (1-based into tex); s an index into `state`; no the material number (record +0x18 bits 23-30, the mNN of its name); at the alpha test [func, ref] from record +0x1c (bit 20 enable, bits 21-23 func in the game enum, 4 = GREATER, bits 8-15 ref), absent when the test is off. `state`: blend from the BS record; ds from the write bit of the DS record (bit 1; DSZTestWrite = writes depth, DSZTest = does not -- dsRom keeps the own name of the record); cull from the RS record word 0 bits 24-25 (2 back, 1 front, 0 none) and bias its s32 word 1 (-32 per RSMeshBiasN step). Normal, LUT and extend maps are not drawn.
